mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.team_id, d.title, d.content, d.created_by, u.username AS created_by_name, d.created_at, d.updated_at FROM hackathon_team_docs d LEFT JOIN users u ON d.created_by = u.id WHERE d.team_id = #{teamId} ORDER BY d.created_at DESC

SELECT d.id, d.team_id, d.title, d.content, d.created_by, u.username AS created_by_name, d.created_at, d.updated_at FROM hackathon_team_docs d LEFT JOIN users u ON d.created_by = u.id WHERE d.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hackathon_team_docs (team_id, title, content, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{teamId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{createdBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
